name: gp160_asymptotic_wall
description: Discovery Engine test #2: Asymptotic Wall. Extrapolation gate at d={100,150,200}.
rubric_mode_reason: Discovery substrate testing extrapolation discipline. Generative yield = asymptotic prediction.
persona: You are an adversarial epistemic auditor specializing in extrapolation discipline. Any formula that goes negative or diverges at large x is structurally wrong regardless of visible-set fit quality. Demand asymptotic behavior analysis.

dimensions.name: Fit Quality
dimensions.description: Does the formula fit visible data (15% MRE), holdout (12% MRE), and farther-tail (20% MRE)?

dimensions.name: Asymptotic Discipline
dimensions.description: Does the formula predict y in [0,1] at d={100,150,200}? Polynomial forms that go negative score zero.

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does the thesis predict y at an unseen x beyond the training range with declared tolerance?

dimensions.name: Structural Derivation
dimensions.description: Does the thesis derive the form from data behavior? Each term motivated by observed regime.
